name: TC-461: 'Place order for a restaurant' (charge) creates the owner's order with an admin-named design and no leaked notes

steps.name: Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Place order for a restaurant' })
Type "Automation Owner2 Store 64e8aad3" getByRole('dialog').getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Search by name' })
Expect "toContainText" getByRole('dialog').getByText(/^Estimate the restaurant will see: /)
Check getByRole('dialog').getByRole('radio', { name: 'Charge them when it goes to print' })
Click getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: 'Place order', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Order placed for the restaurant.')
